summary: The agent-registry/default slice matches the milestone scope: agent creation is append-only, the first agent becomes the global default automatically, explicit set-default appends a new default fact, and the CLI exposes create/agents/set-default/status with human-readable output.

checks.name: append-only ledger facts and derived default resolution
checks.notes: The registry reads only `agents.jsonl`, derives the current state from facts, appends `agent_created` and `workspace_default_set` events, and never mutates a sidecar summary file.

checks.name: first-create auto-default and explicit set-default semantics
checks.notes: `createAgent()` auto-appends the first default only when no default exists, while later default changes require an explicit `setGlobalDefaultAgent()` call.

checks.name: human-facing CLI surface for create/agents/set-default/status
checks.notes: The CLI validates the workspace path and provider/model tuple, prints clear create/set-default confirmations, and exposes registry/status inspection without entering the interactive runtime.
